Well, when you link the page, the Voat site cant load the image through its "expando" (ask me if you dont know what this is), because its now a page rather than a file. When you have the page, which embeds the image plus some other stuff, like adverts and headers and stuff, you have multiple things, but when you navigate to the file, that is, just the gif in the browser and nothing else, you have a URL (again, ask me if...) which links to a file that Voat can then feed through its code and present on one click. This saves the user "clicking through" to the page and lets them load the image directecly in Voats page through the expando. (the little plus icon next to a video or image)
